patterns.note: The site employs a full-viewport, scroll-driven section replacement, where each major content block (hero, project, contact) occupies the entire screen and transitions vertically to reveal the next.
A distinctive, large outlined sans-serif typeface is used for the primary call to action in the footer, contrasting with the clean, minimal sans-serif used for all other text.
A high-contrast palette of near-white background and dark text is consistently used, punctuated by full-bleed, dark-themed project visuals that introduce their own internal color schemes.
As the user scrolls, entire content sections slide upwards out of view, and new full-viewport sections slide in from the bottom, creating a sequential, screen-by-screen browsing experience.
Portfolio projects are presented as full-bleed, immersive experiences that take over the entire viewport during the scroll sequence, rather than being part of a traditional grid layout.

technique_notes: The primary navigation remains sticky at the top right of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent access.

Content sections are designed to fill the entire viewport, and a scroll-driven animation system orchestrates their vertical replacement. As one section scrolls out of view, the next section slides in to occupy the full screen, creating a 'vertical carousel' effect.
The 'Get in touch' section features extremely large, outlined text, achieved by rendering a bold typeface with a transparent fill and a thick stroke, making it a prominent visual element.

design_tokens.type_scale: A mix of medium-large headings, small uppercase labels, and an extremely oversized, outlined display text for key calls to action.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant whitespace around hero content and between full-viewport sections.

standout: This site stands out for its extreme minimalism and the bold use of full-viewport, scroll-driven content replacement, creating an immersive, almost gallery-like experience for portfolio pieces. The oversized, outlined 'Get in touch' text serves as a memorable and distinctive design element.
